## Pushed-back comments

### Comment R1.4 — Re-run analysis with a different statistical test
Reviewer R1.4: "Please re-run the primary analysis using a mixed-effects model to account for variation across settings."
Push-back defense: The requested test (mixed-effects model) requires repeated measures from the same subjects across settings, which the current observational dataset does not contain. We respectfully retain the current pooled comparison and note this limitation in the Discussion.
Status: DEFENDED
